verdict.rationale: Abacum's revenue-planning use-case page says it connects pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model. Separate pages state it connects CRM data and runs forecasts against live actuals in the same governed workspace, which covers building a revenue plan from CRM pipeline and tracking it against actuals. The evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: any evidence of subscription/billing-system data sources, detail on plan-vs-actual variance views, in-depth product documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
